text: So, ok, thats a problem though, because i have no ability to control all the layers at one time to be able to size the entire piece correctly so i have to merge every layer to do so
resolution: Original ask behind req_1692: give the ability to control all layers of a model at once to size the whole piece without merging. Investigated and found the capability already exists end-to-end (the all-parts gizmo from req_1287 transforms every layer together about a shared centroid, with working uniform and per-axis resize), so the gap was purely that its toggle was hidden in a horrible toolbar location and reset every session. Resolved under req_1692 (commit e18a010d1): relocated the toggle next to the object-mode tab, made it prominent and self-describing ('size all N layers'), and persisted it as twig state. No default/behavior change. This pairs with req_1687 (props now place on each layer of a multi-shelf model), so the user no longer needs to merge layers for either sizing or prop placement.
